earnings_inflection_basis: ebitda margin -6.6% (-3.6pp YoY); EBITDA not positive; 0.6*margin(+5pp=1) + 0.4*leverage
valuation_asymmetry_basis: P/S 3.3x / growth 10% = 0.32 (market cap not EV; single-period growth; lower is better)
